text:
sara (marketing): Heads-up — we need a short, customer-facing status update for the latency spike this morning. Ops wants to publish in a staggered way so we don't trigger a support surge. Thoughts on wording and timing? :thinking:

dan (ops): Can do staggered. Suggest initial brief at T+30 with really short blurb, followed by a fuller update at T+90 once we have mitigation ETA. Keep it calm and actionable. :white_check_mark:

jess (cust-succ): Please include which customers are impacted (hosted vs dedicated) — we should route inbounds. We can triage dedicated customers immediately. :phone:

sara (marketing): Agreed. Draft idea for T+30: one-line + link to status page and a note about routing. Example: "We're investigating elevated API latency for a subset of Hosted inference requests. We're prioritizing dedicated customers; temporary mitigation in progress. More details on status.redwood.ai" — too wordy?

lee (product): Shorter is better. Remove "temporary mitigation" — ops can say "mitigations underway". Also call out recommended action for customers: retry with linear backoff or switch to a compatible model variant if supported.

mike (eng-oncall): For technical customers add a fine-print note we may serve degraded throughput for non-pinned routes. ETA TBD but we'll report at T+90. Also we need to avoid promising an ETA until we have it.

sara (marketing): OK final T+30 draft (short): "We're investigating elevated API latency affecting a subset of Hosted requests. Mitigations underway; dedicated customers are being prioritized. See status.redwood.ai for updates and guidance on retry/backoff."

sara (marketing): Pasting as a single-line status copy for internal approval. If approved I'll publish and schedule T+90 fuller update with webhook and webinar hold note.

dan (ops): Approved. Publish at :clock9: 30 mins from now. Add incident ID #INC-20240313-01 in the status link.

jess (cust-succ): For inbound routing: auto-tag any support threads with "latency-spike" and route to dedicated-customer queue immediately. I'll notify CS reps to stand by for high-value customers.

sara (marketing): T+90 fuller update — draft outline: 1) Root cause (brief), 2) Impact matrix (hosted vs dedicated/region), 3) What we did (mitigations), 4) Recommended customer actions, 5) Next steps + links to webinar office hours for affected customers. Want me to include a sign-up link for the quick webinar?

lee (product): Yes. Keep webinar optional — "office hours for affected customers". Capture a short registration with priority slots for enterprise/dedicated customers. No public marketing shout-out.

mike (eng-oncall): For the T+90 detailed text here's a suggested technical snippet to paste under "What we did":

```
- Identified autoscaler edge case leading to throttled GPU assignment for bursty prefix patterns.
- Applied emergency autoscaler policy override to free capacity and reroute traffic to warmed replicas.
- Continuing KV-cache warmup to restore steady-state latency; monitoring token-level tail latency.
```

mike (eng-oncall): That's safe to publish at a high level. Remove internal-only words (e.g., "KV-cache warmup") for the public copy or add a simplified parenthetical.

sara (marketing): Good catch. I'll simplify: "we routed traffic to warmed replicas and are monitoring recovery; further technical notes available on request"

dan (ops): On timing: publish T+30 public blurb, T+90 detailed status + office hours registration (email + link), then T+240 follow-up closure/summary. That should space the inbound load.

jess (cust-succ): For routing rules: automation will tag priority customers and create follow-up tasks for reps for anyone who signs up for office hours. We'll include a short script for reps. I can draft that in #support later.

sara (marketing): Need translations for EU/FR/DE — prioritize EU first. Dan, can you confirm T+30 will go to EU timezone at same moment (we'll localize copy in the channel)?

dan (ops): Yes we'll publish globally at the same UTC time; marketing to handle localized short copy. Keep the link consistent: status.redwood.ai/INC-20240313-01.

lee (product): One more ask — include an internal-only snippet in the T+90 update (not visible publicly) with "affected models list" so support can triage faster. We'll gate that behind internal CS access.

sara (marketing): Makes sense. We'll put the public post + internal detailed note. I'll add a small checkbox in the publish workflow: "include internal triage notes".

mike (eng-oncall): After T+90, I'll put a pinned message in #eng-oncall with timeline & logs if needed.

sara (marketing): Final checklist before T+30:
- [x] Ops OK on wording and timing
- [x] CS routing rules in place (jess)
- [x] Status page link & incident ID (dan)
- [x] EU localization plan (sara)
- [x] Internal triage note ready for T+90 (lee)

sara (marketing): I'll publish in 30. Quick request — please do not amplify to social/webinar lists until we confirm recovery post-T+90. Keep messaging confined to status page + customer emails for now.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-20240313-01 created by dan at 1746991200. Current severity: S2.

sara (marketing): Thanks everyone — posting now. Will update thread with published timestamp and link. :rocket:
